# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

We as members, contributors, and leaders pledge to make participation in **`reCart`** a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, visible or invisible disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, caste, color, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

## Our Standards

Examples of behavior that contributes to a positive environment:

- Demonstrating empathy and kindness toward other people
- Respecting clean-room reverse-engineering boundaries and copyright hygiene
- Giving and gracefully accepting constructive technical feedback
- Focusing on what is best for the overall community and project

Examples of unacceptable behavior:

- Publishing or redistributing copyrighted retail ROMs, disk images, or vendor BIOS files
- Harassment, trolling, insulting/derogatory comments, or personal attacks
- Publishing others' private information (PII) without explicit permission

## Enforcement Responsibilities

Project maintainers are responsible for clarifying and enforcing our standards of acceptable behavior and may remove, edit, or reject comments, commits, code, issues, and other contributions that are not aligned with this Code of Conduct.

## Attribution

This Code of Conduct is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org), version 2.1.
